treatment.logline: At a rain-lashed village sluice, Aruni recognises her brother, discovers a marked key still in his grasp, and fails to reach the one person she needs.

arc.feeling: Bleak space contracts into personal shock.

arc.beat: Restraint gives way to a concrete mystery
arc.feeling: Tenderness held back; attention catches on the key.
Urgency without release, surrounded by indifferent rain.
An unresolved question carries into the title.

treatment.approach: Play the crime-thriller facet as an ominous discovery, not an action spectacle. Scoped village direction governs: locked frames, amber and earthy red within directional dawn light, deep wet shadows and restrained colour. Length comes from recognition, examination and the unanswered wait, not invented events. Essential master, restrained singles and the two readable objects form the intended cut; no decorative coverage.

treatment.geography: The paddy path runs left to right toward the canal gate. Aruni remains frame left facing right; Nimal lies frame right beside the gate from the first frame in which he is visible. Keep the camera on the field side of that axis. Choose his right fist for C-17. Aruni retains the medical bag in her left hand; her right hand approaches his hand, then withdraws and retrieves her phone from her right pocket. Neither key nor bag changes ownership.
treatment.key_image: The exposed C-17 marking in a still fist while rain stipples the metal.
advice: Keep Nimal completely still in every frame; rain supplies movement.
Conceal the actual hand contact behind Aruni's forearm; cut between approach and settled contact rather than generating contact mechanics.
Show the handset and its readable Dinu contact screen before initiating the attempt; no connected-call imagery or answering voice.
Make black and the title in post from clean black source plates; title wording is supplied only in editorial instructions.
Sustain rain without music, with the distant horn only after the unanswered attempt.

editor_notes: The bin contains 13 must takes totalling 58 seconds, including handles and two black sources; this is raw material, not a locked 58-second assembly. Hold recognition, the key reaction and the unanswered wait to shape the scene toward the stated 60 seconds.
The path master establishes geography; the gate master and recognition single establish the still figure and Aruni's response. Match her left-to-right eyeline and the rain between them.

The kneeling two-shot establishes her reach with the meeting of hands occluded. Cut to the settled single; avoid generating or showing hand-to-hand contact mechanics. Nimal remains entirely still, with C-17 in his right fist.
The key detail and reaction are essential to the mystery. Keep the key in the fist and replace the C-17 marking in post if generated lettering is unstable.

L4 is performed in full in the close single; keep its lead and tail, with no answering voice. The phone appears only after the appeal; the close view establishes the Dinu contact screen before one deliberate activation. Replace the screen text in post if necessary; never show a connected call.
Match the two locked kneeling singles on bag in left hand, phone in right, eyeline and rain. Add the distant bus horn under rain only in the latter, then cut directly to black.

Silent-source takes should receive the continuous rain bed, footsteps, fabric, breathing and the distant horn in sound post as appropriate; no music. The black plates can be substituted with editorial black; composite EKAMA SAKSHIYA as a clean title.

Speed ramps, freeze frames, digital punch-ins and split screens are post-only options, not generated moves; no such effects are required here. The locked sources remain clean. Avoid slow motion, mirrors, rapid finger work and generated typography.
Nimal's pre-discovery position is chosen at the canal gate, outside the opening path frame; the phone starts in Aruni's right pocket. The left-hand medical bag remains with her through the end.

editor_notes: The bin contains 13 must takes totalling 58 seconds, including handles and two black sources; this is raw material, not a locked 58-second assembly. Hold recognition, the key reaction and the unanswered wait to shape the scene toward the stated 60 seconds.
The path master establishes geography; the gate master and recognition single establish the still figure and Aruni's response. Match her left-to-right eyeline and the rain between them.

The kneeling two-shot establishes her reach with the meeting of hands occluded. Cut to the settled single; avoid generating or showing hand-to-hand contact mechanics. Nimal remains entirely still, with C-17 in his right fist.
The key detail and reaction are essential to the mystery. Keep the key in the fist and replace the C-17 marking in post if generated lettering is unstable.

L4 is performed in full in the close single; keep its lead and tail, with no answering voice. The phone appears only after the appeal; the close view establishes the Dinu contact screen before one deliberate activation. Replace the screen text in post if necessary; never show a connected call.
Match the two locked kneeling singles on bag in left hand, phone in right, eyeline and rain. Add the distant bus horn under rain only in the latter, then cut directly to black.

Silent-source takes should receive the continuous rain bed, footsteps, fabric, breathing and the distant horn in sound post as appropriate; no music. The black plates can be substituted with editorial black; composite EKAMA SAKSHIYA as a clean title.

Speed ramps, freeze frames, digital punch-ins and split screens are post-only options, not generated moves; no such effects are required here. The locked sources remain clean. Avoid slow motion, mirrors, rapid finger work and generated typography.
Nimal's pre-discovery position is chosen at the canal gate, outside the opening path frame; the phone starts in Aruni's right pocket. The left-hand medical bag remains with her through the end.

review.why: The locked wide already gives the exposed approach and geography; another view would dilute its restraint.
The geography master and held recognition reaction already preserve the uninterrupted reveal and its first change.
The descent and settled single supply the necessary restraint while keeping contact occluded.
The readable C-17 fist detail and Aruni's eyeline reaction already deliver the central discovery without a redundant insert.
The left-hand bag-grip insert gives contained physical strain under L4 while preserving the locked performance.
The tighter oblique held reaction isolates Aruni's eyes during the unanswered wait, complementing the existing phone insert and medium single.
A short rain-struck canal detail carries the existing distant horn and provides an indifferent endpoint before black without showing a bus.
The clean hard cut to black needs no generated transition or embellishment.
The supplied title belongs alone on the clean black source, composited in post.
